Yorick: +@HealthMult*100@% Health
Azir: +@DamageMult*100@% Damage
Mama Beak: +@DamageMult*100@% Damage
Zyra: +@NumExtraAttacks@ Plant Attacks
(@MinUnits@) Empower Summons
(@MinUnits@) Improve each effect by 50%

traits.name: Blossom
traits.desc:
After combat, your Wisps are empowered.

Blossom champions gain Attack Damage, Ability Power, and @BonusHealth*100@% max Health.
(@MinUnits@) Wisps are upgraded, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) Wisps are in every shop, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) Gain @GoldPerCharmPurchased@ gold after buying a Wisp, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) You can buy 2 Wisps per round, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) Wisps overflow with power, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%

traits.name: Emerald Aspect
traits.desc: Drag an ally onto your strongest Taric to pair them, granting the ally powerful bonuses from Taric's Ability.
